mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project ( category_id, creator_id, title, content_blocks, goal_amount, current_amount, end_at, status ) VALUES ( #{command.categoryId}, #{creatorId}, #{command.title}, #{command.contentBlocks}, #{command.goalAmount}, #{command.currentAmount}, #{command.endAt}, #{command.status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id as rewardId, project_id as projectId, title, description, price, stock, created_at as createdAt FROM reward WHERE project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.id as projectId, COALESCE(c.name, '미분류') as categoryName, COALESCE(u.nickname, '알 수 없음') as creatorNickname, p.title, p.content_blocks as contentBlocks, p.goal_amount as goalAmount, p.current_amount as currentAmount, p.end_at as endAt, p.status FROM project p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.creator_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{projectId}
SELECT id as projectId, title, goal_amount as goalAmount, current_amount as currentAmount, end_at as endAt, status, created_at as createdAt FROM project WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId}

SELECT p.id as pledgeId, u.id as userId, u.name as userName, u.email as email, u.phone as phoneNumber, r.title as rewardTitle, p.fulfillment_status as fulfillmentStatus, p.amount as pledgeAmount, p.project_id as projectId FROM pledge p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN reward r ON p.reward_id = r.id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.id as pledgeId, u.id as userId, u.name as userName, u.email as email, u.phone as phoneNumber, r.title as rewardTitle, p.fulfillment_status as fulfillmentStatus, p.amount as pledgeAmount, p.project_id as projectId FROM pledge p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN reward r ON p.reward_id = r.id WHERE p.id = #{pledgeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET status = CASE WHEN current_amount >= goal_amount THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'CANCELED' END WHERE status = 'ONGOING' AND end_at < #{now}
